summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The VanEck Energy Income ETF (EINC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in energy equity. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of North American companies in midstream energy segments. EINC was launched on Mar 13, 2012 and is issued by VanEck.

holdings.infoBox: EINC is an equity ETF with a total of 31 individual holdings. The top holdings are Enbridge stock at 8.04%, The Williams Companies at 7.88%, TC Energy at 6.94%, Cheniere Energy at 6.81%, and Kinder Morgan at 6.27%.
